none: PAS HAMP-307E50: Roman coin : contemporary copy of a nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Hampshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

An incomplete copper-alloy possible contemporary copy of a Roman nummus of the House of Constantine dating to the period AD 318-324 (Reece Period 16), BEATA TRANQVILLITAS reverse type depicting an altar inscribed VOTIS XX with a globe on top. Uncertain mint
